title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holding steady at eighty-one thousand—up point-seven percent overnight. Fear and Greed sits neutral at forty-seven, mixed signals across the board.

Here's what matters: the halving's tightening supply while hashrate proves the network's bulletproof. That's scarcity meeting security. Marty's reading the Fed's rate hike endgame as Bitcoin's opening—and he's onto something. The monetary grip tightens, Bitcoin's deflationary defense gets louder. Andreas is calling a hundred-K move off this
